_comment: Copy to spammanager.customizations.json and edit for your deployment. It drives the 'local customizations' panel on the Spam Manager overview tab, which checks whether your local changes survived the last `update.sh` (it merges with -X theirs, so tracked files you modified can be reverted). Paths are as seen from inside the php-fpm container. Keep your real file out of version control: it describes your deployment.
